parts.text: The diagram shows a six-sided die and a coin. The numbers on the faces of the die are 1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 3. When the die is rolled it is equally likely for any of the six faces to be on the top. When the coin is spun it is equally likely to land showing heads or tails.

content.tex: The diagram shows a six-sided die and a coin.
The numbers on the faces of the die are \(1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 3.\)
When the die is rolled it is equally likely for any of the six faces to be on the top. When the coin is spun it is equally likely to land showing heads or tails.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Abi rolls the die. Write down the probability that it shows the number 3 on the top. .................................................... [1]

content.tex: Write down the probability that it shows the number 3 on the top.

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Beatrice rolls the die and spins the coin.

content.tex: Beatrice rolls the die and spins the coin.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Find the probability that the die shows the number 2 on the top and the coin shows heads. .................................................... [2]

content.tex: Find the probability that the die shows the number 2 on the top and the coin shows heads.

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Find the probability that the die shows the number 2 on the top or the coin shows heads or both. .................................................... [2]

content.tex: Find the probability that the die shows the number 2 on the top or the coin shows heads or both.

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Carl spins the coin 3 times. Find the probability that the coin shows heads at least once. .................................................... [2]

content.tex: Find the probability that the coin shows heads at least once.

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Drew rolls the die 3 times and records the numbers on the top. Find the probability that the die shows each of the numbers, 1, 2 and 3, once. .................................................... [3]

content.tex: Drew rolls the die 3 times and records the numbers on the top.
Find the probability that the die shows each of the numbers, \(1, 2\) and 3, once.

parts.label: e
parts.text: (e) Eva spins the coin n times. The probability that the coin shows tails each time is 64 1 . Find the value of n . n = ................................................... [1]

content.tex: Eva spins the coin \(n\) times. The probability that the coin shows tails each time is \(\frac{1}{64}\) .

parts.label: f
parts.text: (f) Frank rolls the die twice and records the two numbers. The probability of these two numbers occurring is 3 1 . Find these two numbers. ................... and ................... [2]

content.tex: Frank rolls the die twice and records the two numbers. The probability of these two numbers occurring is \(\frac{1}{3}\) .
